name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Riesböckhof
beschreibung: The Riesböckhof in Ebbs, Tyrol, offers welcoming holiday apartments within an authentic, traditional farmhouse. Each of the holiday flats is individually furnished and provides ample space for relaxing family holidays. Cradled by the picturesque scenery of the Tyrolean Unterland, the farm gives guests a genuine look into daily agricultural life and friendly farm animals. The surrounding landscape is ideal for mountain walks in the Kaisergebirge and panoramic bike tours. A children's play area and garden are available on-site, while the nearby cultural fortress town of Kufstein is well worth exploring.
